hero.heading: Building peace and resilience across rural Sudan.
hero.subhead: We partner with local leaders to advance education, water access, and community-led peacebuilding — from Darfur and Kordofan to the Blue Nile.
hero.imageAlt: The pyramids of Meroë rising from the desert in Northern Sudan

home.missionBody1: The Sudanese Rural Community (SRC) works alongside community advisory boards in fifteen states to deliver education, water, health, and peacebuilding programs designed by Sudanese communities themselves.
home.missionBody2: Our methodology is grounded in three principles: local ownership of every project, transparent reporting to donors and beneficiaries, and durable partnerships with traditional leaders, women's cooperatives, and youth councils.
home.quote: Dignity is the foundation of peace. We don't deliver aid — we partner with rural communities to build the tools they need for their own prosperity.
home.reportBody: A complete breakdown of programs, finances, and impact across all fifteen states where SRC operates.
home.ctaBody: Your support funds clean water, classrooms, and community-led peace councils where they're needed most.
